title: Sonnambula
html_source:
Vincenzo Bellini’s La Sonnambula (Elvino’s aria and cabaletta from Act II) (Tutto è sciolto… Ah! perché non posso odiarti……)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bx0x20uNHIc

anchor.prefix:
iver, mashed, at meat fit for princes sat princes Bloom and Goulding. Princes at meat they raised and drank Power and cider. 

 Most beautiful tenor air ever written, Richie said:
anchor.suffix:
. He heard Joe Maas sing that one night. Ah, what M'Guckin! Yes. In his way. Choirboy style. Maas was the boy. Massboy. A lyrical tenor if you like. Never forget it. Never. 

1986#
